audit_items.proof_trace: burn_ctokens computes redeem_collateral_amount = exchange_rate.int_mul(ctokens.value()), where int_mul implements floor(exchange_rate * ctokens) via integer division ((a.value * b) / WAD). The returned balance is exactly this pre-computed amount — no rounding direction that overpays is possible. Interest is always accrued before the exchange rate is read (handle_withdraw calls refresh_obligation_assets_interest at market.move:326 before invoking burn_ctokens at line 345), so the rate is current. The property holds as coin_received = floor(exchange_rate * ctokens) ≤ exchange_rate * ctokens, with truncation intentionally favoring the protocol.
